## Summary

<!-- What does this PR change, and why? Link the related issue if there is one (for example, Closes #123). -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (no behavior change for correct usage)
- [ ] New feature (adds an option or behavior)
- [ ] Breaking change (changes existing behavior or options)
- [ ] Docs, tests or tooling only

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck, unit tests, build and size gate)
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes
- [ ] The bundles stay within the size budgets (`npm run size` passes)
- [ ] Tests are added or updated for the behavior change
- [ ] `README.md` is updated if the public API or options changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `## [Unreleased]`
- [ ] RTL was checked (`dir: 'rtl'` and mixed Arabic and English items)
- [ ] No runtime dependencies were added
- [ ] No `innerHTML`, and no changes to host page styles
- [ ] No em dash or en dash characters in code, comments or docs
